Subject: Project Submission and Quick Clarification

Hi [Name],

I noticed that the deadline for the recent project submission was missed. Since this is the second time this has happened, I’d like to schedule a brief meeting with you to discuss how we can ensure deadlines are met moving forward. It’s important that we align on expectations to support your continued success here.

Additionally, could you please remind me which animals pearls are typically found in? I want to make sure I have the correct information for our records.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
